items.title: Ed Allen Interview, 1961-01-14
items.q: Like Johnny Sensen said, George Foster on the guitar after Johnny Sensen said, Johnny Sensen said was one of the first time I'd seen a guy play a six-strain band.

ctx.x: Do you remember any musicians in New Orleans that were particularly good?

There was a trumpet player that I had called Kid Punch. I don't know how to grow him. I knew a very bunch of musicians that I had forgotten. And then Kid, it seemed like the old name, Kid something. I had forgotten. I used to hang out with a bunch of them. I don't remember now, it's been so many years ago. You thought Punch was good on trumpet? Yeah. I always admired the trumpet players in New Orleans. I only had the swing. I always liked the swing. The majority didn't do much reading in New Orleans but they…
He goes way back too. I didn't think he was that old.
